description: Price a job after a site visit. Give the job, customer, labour (time, priced from the saved rate), materials (trade cost, marked up), other costs and optional extras; the server applies VAT correctly (registered or not, 20/5/0%, the construction domestic reverse charge for contractor customers), the deposit rule, validity, exclusions and a running quote number. Returns the totals, the trade-only margin view, warnings, a check_before_sending list of commonly forgotten items for that trade, and the links to the PDF and the customer's phone page (a DRAFT until finalise_quote). from_quote copies a past quote's lines for a new customer. save false returns the numbers without saving.

assumptions.description: What the price assumes, for example "Clear access to the loft".

customer.description: Who the quote is for. type: homeowner, landlord, tenant, business (buying for itself) or contractor (a builder or main contractor buying your work). For business or contractor customers also give vat_registered, cis_registered and end_user, because they decide whether the construction domestic reverse charge applies.

end_user.description: True if this business customer is the end user of the work (not selling it on).

deposit.description: Override the trade's usual deposit rule for this quote only. Deposit rule. basis percent (with percent), fixed (with amount in pounds), materials (deposit equals the materials total), or none. no_deposit_under: no deposit on quotes below this total in pounds.

discount.description: Optional discount before VAT: percent OR amount (pounds), with a short reason the customer sees.

duration.description: Time on site, for example "3 working days".

exclusions.description: What is NOT included in this job, one short sentence each. Added to the trade's standard exclusions.

from_quote.description: Start from this past quote. Fields you send replace that quote's fields; customer is required.

labour.description: Labour lines. Give days OR hours (time on the job, per person) and the server prices it from the trade's saved rate; or give a fixed price in pounds. rate: trade (default, the trade's own rate) or labourer (their mate or apprentice rate). people: how many on site for that time. rate_override: a one-off day or hour rate in pounds.

vat_category.description: VAT treatment of this line if the trade is VAT registered. standard = 20% (almost all repair, maintenance and installation work). reduced_5 = 5% (home empty 2+ years, conversion into a different number of homes, grant-funded heating). zero_energy_saving = 0% until 31 March 2027 for installing insulation, heat pumps, solar panels, batteries or heating controls in a home (NOT gas or oil boilers). zero_new_build = building a new home. zero_disabled = adaptations for a disabled person (needs their signed declaration). outside_scope = a fee paid on the customer's behalf at cost. Default standard. Ignored if the trade is not VAT registered.

materials.description: Materials. unit_cost is what the TRADE pays per unit in pounds; the server adds their markup. Set cost_includes_vat true if the price came from a receipt or shelf price including VAT (the server strips it for VAT registered trades). Give a saved code instead of description and unit_cost to use the price book. Prices used here are remembered for next time.

unit.description: each, m, drum, tin, box, lot, m2...

Default standard. Ignored if the trade is not VAT registered.

notes.description: Anything else the customer should read.

optional_extras.description: Optional upgrades the customer can tick when accepting (for example an EV charger, a smart thermostat, extra sockets). price in pounds before VAT. Up to 6. Not included in the main total.

Default standard. Ignored if the trade is not VAT registered.

other.description: Other costs charged as a set amount in pounds (ex VAT): skip hire, scaffolding, waste disposal, certification or notification fees, parking. qty multiplies the amount (for example scaffold per week).

Default standard. Ignored if the trade is not VAT registered.

remember_prices.description: Default true: material prices used here go into the price book.

save.description: Default true. false = preview the numbers only, nothing saved, no quote number used.

site_address.description: Job address, if different from the customer's address.

summary.description: Two to four plain sentences describing the work as found on the visit, written for the customer. No jargon they would not understand.

title.description: Short job name the customer sees, for example "Full rewire, 3 bedroom semi" or "Replace combi boiler".

trade.description: Which trade this job is, if the business does more than one. Drives the check_before_sending list.

trade_key.description: The trade's secret key from setup_trade (starts qbk_).

validity_days.description: How many days the prices hold. Defaults to the trade's setting (usually 30).
